scenario: Probe a staging AI-agent workflow for prompt-injection, tool-abuse, and cost-blowup failures with no known symptom.

outcome_contract.primary: Human can act on confirmed breakages without re-deriving workflow intent, and hand them to debug-investigation.
guardrails: synthetic payloads unless real data explicitly authorized
live or destructive probe requires recorded approval and blast-radius signoff
escalation reason recorded when mode or council level increases
